item.content:encoded:
Show me how it's done;
you're a salesman's son...

I've been floating the idea of a 952 tale series since the OCT enrollment period. Granted, I thought I'd have it out before the OCT started, but ce la vie.

It's about time I take my first step into stupid ambitious projects. Today's the sixth anniversary of my wikidot membership, after all.

EDIT: as per my promise to A Random Day, if SCP-952 gets to +300 I'll reveal which member of HoS is a Weezer fan.
